all.source_quote: Must belong to SC/ST/OBC community and possess a valid caste certificate.

any.source_quote: varies slightly for OBC depending on scheme/state

all.source_quote: Must be a regular/full-time student enrolled in school.

unmodelled.text: Must study in a recognised school; the class range is generally 9 to 10, and 1 to 10 in some variants
unmodelled.source_quote: Studying in a recognized school (generally Class 9 - 10 for SC/ST/OBC schemes;

unmodelled.text: OBC students have their own income limit, which the page does not give
unmodelled.source_quote: Annual family income limit should not exceed: Rs 2.5 lakh for SC/ST students (varies slightly for OBC depending on scheme/state).

unmodelled.text: Renewals need a pass in the previous exam
unmodelled.source_quote: Progression requirement: Students should have passed the previous examination (for renewal cases).

unmodelled.text: Must not get another scholarship for the same purpose
unmodelled.source_quote: Only one scholarship at a time: Student should not be availing another scholarship for the same purpose.

unmodelled.text: Must be domiciled in West Bengal
unmodelled.source_quote: Domicile requirement: Must belong to the state/UT from where applying.

ambiguous: Source is a short summary by the Department of Information & Cultural Affairs on wb.gov.in, not the scheme's own guidelines
The class range is not fixed on the page (Class 9-10 generally, Class 1-10 in some variants), so it is not modelled
The OBC income limit is not stated, so OBC students are not income-checked here

en.title: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC, ST and OBC Students (West Bengal)
en.benefit: Monthly maintenance allowance, tuition and compulsory fees, and extra help for hostel students and students with disabilities.
en.how_to_apply: Register on oasis.wb.gov.in (OTR ID), apply online with caste and income certificates, and the school forwards it for verification.
